Module com.example.demo
Package com.example.miniproyecto4.model

Class Ship

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto4.model.Ship
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Ship extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a ship that belongs to a player's fleet. A ship stores its name, size, occupied coordinates, orientation, and the coordinates that have been hit during the match. It also provides operations to determine whether the ship has been placed and whether it has been completely sunk.
